## InvalidOfferParameterError class

Thrown when an offer builder receives a parameter that cannot satisfy Midnight protocol rules.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export declare class InvalidOfferParameterError extends Error
```
**Extends:** Error

## Remarks

Parameter details:

- `params.parameter`<!-- -->: Invalid offer parameter name.

- `params.value`<!-- -->: Invalid offer parameter value.

- `params.instruction`<!-- -->: Optional instruction appended to the error message.

- `params.cause`<!-- -->: Optional wrapped cause.

## Example


```ts
import { InvalidOfferParameterError } from "@morpho-org/midnight-sdk";

throw new InvalidOfferParameterError({ parameter: "tick", value: 5821n });
```
